tei:div.tei:p: 137) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: smin byed dbang gi sta gon smin grol lam bzang bzhugs: 138) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: o rgyan rdo rje 'chang la gus pas 'dud: phyi rabs rjes 'jug smon lam 'phro ldan pa: theg chen la mos dad dang dam tshig ldan: bla ma la gus mched lcam yongs la brtse: 'khor bar blo ldog gdams pa nyams len cing: sgo gsum zol zog med cing chos la spyod: gnad 'di ldan pa'i skal ldan skyes bu yis: sgo gsum dbang gis smin cing grol ba'i thabs: smin grol lam bzang 'di ru bstan par bya: sa ma ya: gnas bzang byin chags 'tshe ba bral ba'i sar: lha dgongs ldan pa'i skyes bus gzhan don phyir: sa slong sa sbyong byin gyis brlabs pa dang: lha dang dkyil 'khor rnam bum sta gon rnams: spyi ltar bsgrubs la gzhung bzhin legs par bkod: de nas slob ma sta gon rim pa la: pad+ma 'das bzhi phyogs mdog dbus mthing ga'i: steng du shar nas brtsams te bum pa dang: rtags kyi so shing zur brgyad sor bcu ldan: sna lnga'i srung skud ku sha'i chun po rnams: g.yas bskor gyis ni ma nor tshul bzhin bkod: de nas khrus kyi bum pa sgrub pa ni: oṃ swa bha wa= shar gyi bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin du thabs shes pad zla'i steng du: hūm̐ dkar yongs gyur dpal ldan rdo rje sems: 139) dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: sku la dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: longs sku'i chas rdzogs mtshan dpe zhi tshul ldan: snang stong ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru shar: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum sa bon las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs ye shes spyan drangs bstim: dam yed dbyer med ro gcig brtan par bzhugs: gnyis med mnyam pa'i gus phyag 'tshal: snang ba sna tshogs mchod pa 'bul:

sku dang ye shes chen por bstod: snang stong gnyis med ye shes lha'i: thugs kar zla ba rgyas pa'i steng: thugs srog hūm̐ la yig drug bskor: 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal kun gyi: thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa bsdus: srog gi snying por ro gcig 'dres: 'khor 'das dag mnyam bde ba che: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: ci 'grub bzlas rjes yig brgya nyer gcig mthar: nyer spyod kyis mchod bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal: sgrib gnyis dri ma 'joms mdzad lha: dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la: sgo gsum 140)gus pa chen pos bstod: ces brjod mthar: bum lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur nas sgo gsum gyi dri ma nyes skyon thams cad sbyong byed kyi nus pa dang ldan par gyur: de nas so shing byin gyis rlob pa ni: oṃ swa bha wa= sogs: so shing mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las lho ru hūm̐ las dpal phyag na rdo rje mthing ga zhal gcig spyan gsum khro zhing gtum pa: phyag gnyis rdo rje dang sbrul zhags 'dzin cing zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs kyis pad nyi'i gdan la 'gying ba: sku la khro bo'i chas rdzogs shing ye shes bskal pa'i me dpung 'khyil pa'i klong du bskyed do: de'i thugs kar pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od kyis sku gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mthu byin nus pa ye shes yon tan thams cad 'od kyi rnam par byung nas sngags phreng dang gnyis su med par gyur: rtsa sngags mthar: badz+ra ha sa ha swā hā: ci 'grub bzlas mthar nyer spyod kyis mchod la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: phrin las mnga' bdag dpal chen po: gar dgu'i nyams ldan khro ba'i rgyal: rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces brjod mthar: 141)lha nyid 'od du zhu nas so shing la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam:

de nas srung skud byin rlabs ni: oṃ swa bha wa= sogs: srung skud rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las nub tu hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gcig spyan gsum khro rngams ldan cing zhabs gnyis pad nyi bam gyi steng du bsgrad cing: dbu skrad mar ser gyen du brdzes shing thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi phreng bas spras shing dur khrod kyi chas thams cad sku la rdzogs par gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du thugs srog hūm̐ ljang sngon gyi mthar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas tshur 'dus pa las rgyal ba rnams kyi gsang gsum 'khor lo'i nus mthu thams cad thob par bsam: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭa: pañca sid+dhi hūm̐: ci 'grub bzlas mthar nyer spyod kyis mchod la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chos nyid 'gyur med kun nas zlum: lhun grub 'gag med rol pa las: thugs rje thabs mkhas skur ston pa: khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil la bstod: ces brjod pas: khro bo 'od du zhu nas srung 142)skud dang dbyer med du gyur: de nas ku sha byin rlabs la: oṃ swa bha wa= ku sha mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la shes rab mnga' bdag 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dmar por zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin zhing zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa: sku la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis spras shing zhi 'dzum mtshan dang dpe byad ldan cing ye shes 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa'i klod du bskyed do: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i gdan la dhīḥyig gi mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od kyis srid zhi'i khams kyi ye shes yon tan mkhyen brtse nus pa thams cad bsdus nas thugs srog la thim par bsam:

oṃ a ra pa tsa mi ta hṛ dā ye swā hā: ci 'grub bzlas mthar nyer spyod kyis mchod la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i ye shes gter 'chang ba: dmar gsal nyi ma 'char 'dra'i mdangs bkra zhing: ma rig blo yi mun pa sel mdzad pa: 'jam dpal dpa' bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces brjod mthar: lha nyid 'od du zhu nas ku sha la thim par gyur: de ltar dbang gi sta gon rim pa rnams: 143)lag len nor 'khrul med par nyams blang nas: tshul bzhin sgrub pa nyams len gnad du gces: skal ldan dam gtsang rjes su 'dzin pa la: sngon la sgo yi mdun gral 'khod nas ni: khrus dang bgegs bskrad srung pa'i 'khor lo bsgom: de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni: kye: sgo skyong khro bo dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams ni: thar pa'i lam du 'jug spro bas: sgo phyes dkyil 'khor nang du 'jug: ces lan gsum brjod: slob dpon gyis: kye ho: khyed cag su yin nga la smos: thar pa'i lam la 'jug spro na: dag tshig tshul bzhin bsrung nus tshe: lam gyi lam mchog bdag gis bstan: zhes dang: yang slob bus: kye ho: gsang ba mchog gi slob dpon dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu: gsang sngags lam la 'jug spro bas: ci bsgo'i bka' las 'da' mi bya: rim gnyis lam mchog bstan du gsol: lan gsum: slob dpon gyis: e ma skal ldan las 'phro can: gsang sngags dbang la ma brten pa: yang dag thar pa'i lam mi rnyed: de phyir gus spro dad pa yis: nang du 'dongs la smin par bya: zhes brjod slob ma gral 'khod cing: yon phul gsol gdab sems bskyed 'bog: de nas so shing 144)thogs la gtad pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi: rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag gi slob ma 'di rnams la: sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i: rigs kyi lha 'di bstan du gsol: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig:

rang gi lag gnyis kyi sor mo rnams kha sbyar ba'i bar du rtags kyi so shing 'di nyid rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i ye shes kyi brda mtshon du dmigs la rang rang las 'brel yod pa'i lha gang yin pa de ngos gzung ba'i phyir mig btsums nas stegs bu'i steng du dor la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: badz+ra ha sa ha: zhes dor bas: shar du babs na rdo rje'i rigs la dbang zhing zhi ba'i las 'grub: lho ru babs na rin chen gyi rigs la dbang zhing rgyas pa'i las 'grub: nub tu babs na pad+ma'i rigs la dbang zhing dbang gi las 'grub: byang du babs na las kyi rigs la dbang zhing drag po'i las 'grub: mtshams rnams su babs na phyogs dang nye ba'i lha bsgrub pa la dbang zhing dngos grub kyang de bzhin du 'thob bo: dbus su 'greng nger gnas na bud+dha'i rigs kyi lha 'grub cing mchog gi dngos grub 'thob bo: rtsa ba rang la bstan nas stegs dang 145)bral na bar chad mang zhing lha la skal ba zhan pa yin pas: tshogs bsags dang skong bshags la 'bad nas slar bskyar bar bya'o: de nas srung skud sbyin pa ni: hoḥ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang: rtsa gsum srung ma'i byin rlabs dang: bdag gi lha sngags ting 'dzin mthus: rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dang: mi mthun phyogs rnams kun las srungs: mchog gi lam nyid mthar phyin shog: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ swā hā: de nas ku sha sbyin pa ni: bla mas: hoḥ rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs rje dang: rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa dang: lha sngags chos nyid dag pa'i mthus: deng 'dir rigs kyi bu rnams la: legs nyes nor 'khrul med pa ru: mngon sum nyid du gsal du gsol: de nas slob bus: hoḥ bla ma lha yi dkyil 'khor du: bdag ni gus pas gsol ba 'debs: bdag la legs sam nyes kyang rung: 'dod don nor 'khrul med pa ru: rmi lam nyid du gsal par mdzod: ces brjod la ku sha sbyin:

de nas yang slob dpon gyis: 'o: ye shes lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i ku sha 'di ni khyod kyi rmi lam brtag pa'i phyir gnang ba yin no: khyod kyi rmi lam du 'das 146)ma 'ongs kun mngon pa'i sngas stan gyis la ci rmis ma gsang bar bdag la smos shig: ces bskul nas slob mas sngas stan bya zhing: bdag la rtsa ba gsum gyis 'das ma 'ongs dge dang mi dge mngon par gsol: zhes gsol ba btab la nyal bas rmi lam dge mi dge gsal bar 'gyur: bzang ngan ci rmis bla ma la zhu bar bya'o: de nas dngos gzhi la 'jug par bya: e ma:zab gsang bla med don gyi snying po yi: smin byed dbang gi sta gon zab mo 'dis: 'phrad tshad 'gro ba smin par the tshom med: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zab mo yi: rtsa lag slob ma rjes 'dzin -i thi rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa 'di yang rang slob tshul khrims rdo rje dang rigs kyi myu gu chos dbyings sgron ma sogs kyis bskul ngor: spom gnas o rgyan sgrub phug gi nye 'dabs nas bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// de nas bla mas 'di skad brjod: 'o skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob bu rnams dgongs 'tshal: rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob: 'phrad par dka' ba dam pa'i chos dang phrad: mjal bar dka' ba bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal: bsam par dka' ba gsang sngags don gnyer gyi bsam pa bzang po rgyud la skyes ba 'di ni shin tu 147)legs te: yang nas yang du 'di ltar du 'byung ba ni shin tu dka' ste u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin no: sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa de bas kyang dkon: de las ches cher dkon pa gsang sngags la 'du shes grung por gnas shing dam tshig mi 'chal bar tshul bzhin du gnas pa shin tu dkon pa yin te: tshe lus gcig po 'di'i steng nas zung 'jug gi sku rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sar gshegs nas 'gro ba yin no:

de lta bu'i rgyu mtshan la legs par dpyod cing don la gnas par byed pa ni gal che bas: dang po thun mong gi chos kyis rang rgyud la nges shes bskyed: bar du le lo med par nyams len gyi mtha' gcig tu dril: mtha' ma 'bras bu phyi dus la mi bzhag par tshe 'dir rang thog tu sad cing gzhon nu bum pa'i skur nying mtshams sbyor nus pa zhig dgos: de ltar grol bar byed pa la yang lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin te: de dag gi sgo 'byed cing gzhi ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni nges par dgos te: dbang gi sgo 'byed pa la yang sta gon gsum sngon du 'gro ba yin phyir bum pa lha yi sta gon gyi rim pa rnams 148)song nas da khyed rang slob ma sta gon du bya ba'i dus la babs pas dga' spro dad gus dang ldan pa'i ngang nas maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: kye hoḥ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje dang: bdag cag smin grol mdzad pa'i phyir: sngon du 'gro ba las kyi dbang: bdag cag rnams la bstsal du gsol: lan gsum gsol: de nas dam tshig gzung ba'i phyir: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag cag 'di bzung byang chub bar: rgyal ba rnams kyi rjes su 'jug: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro: 'gro ba'i don du sems mchog bskyed: so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: dam tshig sdom la gnas bya'i phyir: mgon pos bdag la gnang du gsol: lan gsum gsol: bla mas: kye ma: snod ldan skyes bu dam pa rnams: gsang sngags cho ga bdag gis bstan: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams: mi nyams tshul bzhin bsrung bar gyis: zhes gnang ba sbyin: thal mo me tog dang bcas te: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems: nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang: rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgongs: skang gnyis gtso bor sangs rgyas dang: zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos:

149) tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la: 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar: gus pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi: bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro dang: chos skyong dpa' bo dpa' mor bcas: byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon la: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: bla ma sangs rgyas spyan snga ru: lus ngag yid kyis gzhan rnams la: gnod pa las ldog dge ba bsgrub: dge tshul dge slong byang chub sems: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la: bdag ni rgyun du gnas shing bsrung: 'gro ba ma smin pa dang ni: 'jug pa byang chub sems mchog bskyed: phar phyin drug la rtag tu gnas: sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god: dkon mchog mi gtong rtag tu bsgrub: rdo rje slob dpon mi gtong brnyen: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang: rigs lnga'i dam tshig rtag tu 'dzin: byang chub sems dang 'bral mi bya: sbyin pa dus rnams rgyun du gtong: theg gsum chos la bshad par brtson: 'gro don rgyun mi chad 150)par bsgrub: mdor na rgyal bas gang bsgrags pa'i: dam tshig mi nyams tshul bzhin gzung: zhes lan gsum gyis dam tshig sbyin zhing len: de nas dung zhal thogs la: hoḥ rdo rje khro bo gnod sbyin gyis: byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam tshig 'du: slob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhag: nam yang dam las ma 'da' zhig: sa ma ya na ra kan: dri'i thig le gnas gsum du byugs la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ: brjod pas skye mched kyi gnas rnams su reg cing thig le bkod pas ma dag pa'i gnas nyams yi ge'i rang bzhin du brlabs par bsam: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hoḥ zhes dang: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ grangs med brjod bzhin ḍā dril dkrol zhing: dzaḥhūm̐ bam hoḥs: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams char bzhin babs nas slob ma'i spyi bo nas mar thim nas snying gar bzhugs par bsam mo: gu ru'i thugs sgrub kyi dbang gi sta gon las khol du phyung ba'o/
